name: Mailu
tagline: Simple, full-featured mail server in Docker. For small organizations.
shortDescription: Mailu is a simple, full-featured mail server in Docker. Postfix, Dovecot, Rspamd, Nginx, Admin UI, full DKIM/SPF/DMARC. Designed for small organizations and families.
longDescription:
## What it is

Mailu is a simple, full-featured mail server in Docker. Postfix, Dovecot, Rspamd, Nginx, Rainloop webmail, Admin UI, full DKIM/SPF/DMARC, anti-spam, antivirus. Designed for small organizations (under 100 users).

## Why we recommend it

If you want a self-hosted mail server that's even simpler than Mailcow, Mailu is the answer. The setup is one docker-compose, the admin UI is clean, and the resource requirements are low.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted mail for small organizations (under 100 users)
- Family mail server
- Privacy-focused deployments
- When you want a low-resource mail stack
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/Mailu/Mailu && cd Mailu && docker compose -p mailu up -d
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose:**
```
git clone https://github.com/Mailu/Mailu
cd Mailu
cp .env.dist .env  # edit with your domain
docker compose -p mailu up -d
```
Admin UI at `https://your-server/admin`.
pricingDetails: Free. MIT licensed. Self-host on a 4GB+ VPS.
